Abstract: Did Congress trade ahead of the 2026 Iran War? We examine 135 disclosed transactions made by members of Congress in ten geopolitically exposed industries during the escalation. Members traded heavily in industries that subsequently rose, and congressional trading volume peaked roughly two months before public attention, but they earned no first-mover advantage. We compare portfolios that track congressional transactions at trade dates against portfolios entering at public disclosure dates.
